reference_roles.Q7XZQ6: Multifunctional parsley flavonol synthase/flavanone 3-hydroxylase comparator; not a pure FHT control

comparison_finding: Each leading candidate has higher identity and bit score to Q7XZQ7 than to Q7XZQ8. Alignment lengths and coverage differ; this is descriptive similarity, not a calibrated specificity probability. A0A7J6GGF7 remains fragment-flagged in the prior annotation snapshot.

primary_study.review_scope: Indexed primary abstract and discussion; full methods, tables, constructs and supplements not yet reconciled
primary_study.finding: Combinations of substitutions changed product preference in recombinant parsley hydroxylase; similarity alone cannot establish desaturation specificity.
primary_study.numbering_blocker: The abstract says seven sites but lists eight substitutions. Preserve this discrepancy; do not infer a seven-site panel or transfer numbering to Cannabis without checking constructs and full results.

next_steps: Reconcile study constructs and residue numbering against the pinned parsley sequences before alignment-based site review.
Compare candidate products against authentic apigenin, dihydrokaempferol and kaempferol standards; retain substrate stereochemistry, no-enzyme controls and reference controls.
Retain both desaturation and hydroxylation hypotheses until direct activity evidence discriminates them.
claim_boundary: No new exact enzyme assignment, reaction addition, net-route rescue or completeness increase. Comparators do not become FNS-I reaction candidates merely by being included in this screen.
